description: This file defines API endpoints for managing stock entries in a dealer management system using FastAPI. It includes functions to list, create, update, and delete stock entries, with associated helper functions and data serialization logic.

methods.name: Decimal _q2(value: Decimal)
methods.description: Quantizes a Decimal value to 2 decimal places to match database scale.

methods.name: Decimal _compute_total_cost(unit_cost: Decimal, quantity: Decimal)
methods.description: Computes total cost by multiplying unit cost and quantity, then quantizing.

methods.name: StockEntryOut _to_out(entry: StockEntry)
methods.description: Converts a StockEntry ORM object to its API response schema StockEntryOut.

methods.name: List[StockEntry] list_stock_entries( dealer_id: int | None = Query( None, description="Optional dealer id to filter stock entries", ), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of stock entries to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of stock entries to skip"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list stock entries with optional filtering by dealer_id, pagination, and ordering.

methods.name: StockEntry create_stock_entry(payload: StockEntryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new stock entry, associating it with a dealer, and calculating total cost.

methods.name: StockEntry update_stock_entry( stock_id: int, payload: StockEntryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to update an existing stock entry's details.

methods.name: None delete_stock_entry(stock_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a stock entry by its id.
